quest.title: Vimana Agama: Dev Delver Chapter
quest.description: Somehow, you managed to open the entrance to the underground ruins. Once you find the core in the Dev's Cavern, the truth about the forest's "disease" will be unveiled...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3, Stories of You and the Aranara x1

dialogues.speaker: Jazari
dialogues.text: The gates to scholarship will open to whoever has a seeking heart.

dialogues.speaker: Jazari
dialogues.text: Now go for it with that in mind!

talks.objective: Check the area that was hit

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Ararycan, what are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Ararycan
dialogues.text: Ararycan has been waiting for you here since Ararycan finished sowing the flowers.

dialogues.speaker: Ararycan
dialogues.text: But then, something just fell off the Great Iron Mountain. It almost hit Ararycan!

dialogues.speaker: Ararycan
dialogues.text: Paimon doesn't have to say sorry. Ararycan is fine. Ararycan is a fast runner, so Ararycan didn't get hit.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just glad it didn't hurt you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The robot's severed arm must have broken the entrance to the underground ruins open. Well, at least it wasn't completely useless.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then let's go down and have a look. Who knows what nasty things wait for us down there!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The glowing thing in there must be the Ruin Golem's Chaos Core. Y'know, the one Jazari talked about.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's sealed by branches and vines, but something seems to be flowing out of it.

dialogues.speaker: Ararycan
dialogues.text: Ohh, it's the filthy stuff. Ararycan can feel it. This is what made the forest sick.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, some Abyss Mages seem to be up to something around those big branches. This can't be good...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon remembers Jazari said that the core's seal had been damaged. Maybe these Abyss Mages had something to do with it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, you should go and find a place to hide, Ararycan. Let's stop them!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, it was a long journey, wasn't it?

choices.text: Let's tell this story to Jazari...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh right, if he knows about the core, he can help us apply for some funding and all that stuff.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #But Paimon's not gonna enroll in the Akademiya or anything. You aren't planning to either, right, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, we don't know what Marana's Avatar has to do with the Abyss Order yet, but it's a good thing that we cured the forest's illness all the same.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, what do you plan to do next, Ararycan?

response.speaker: Ararycan
response.text: Ararycan will celebrate Festival Utsava. But Ararycan worries about the forest's illness.

response.speaker: Ararycan
response.text: There's a chance that the bad things that made the forest sick will come back. Ararycan needs to guard the forest.

response.speaker: Ararycan
response.text: So Ararycan will come back here after Festival Utsava.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Wow, Aranara really do have tough jobs.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If you ever need any help, Ararycan, be sure to come to us!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe! Take care of yourself. We'll see each other soon!

choices.text: Let's tell this story to grandpa Royinjan...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh yeah, and grandpa Royinjan will say, "What an interesting story!"

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Who'd know that we actually saved the forest?
